reader.requirement: At --std 85, an OPEN OUTPUT of a report file WITH NO REWIND on a storage medium the phrase does not apply to (every supported medium is non-reel/unit disk) must ignore the phrase: the open proceeds as a normal OUTPUT open (file emptied, report written), is successful, and sets the 1985 Sequential I-O status '07' (VII.1.3.5 1d); an unsuccessful open keeps its own failure status.
reader.edition-search: Read BindOpen, CheckOpenTapePhrase, EmitOpen, OpenTape/OpenCore/OpenArbitrated/NoRewindPhraseEffect; grep -i 'rewind' over WiseOwl.Cobol.Editions and Binding/Passes (only hits: ConstructRegistry.g.cs open-reversed-removed-2002, which gates REVERSED not NO REWIND, and DiagnosticCatalog descriptors); grep 'edition|std|version|Dialect' in Runtime/IO/FileStatus.cs and FileRegistry.cs (the connector's Edition is read only for CLOSE WITH LOCK and relative WRITE, not on the OPEN tape-phrase path). ctx.Edition in the binder is the diagnostic sink only. No edition switch on this path: 85 and 2023 run the same code.

reader.notes: The binder records the per-file tape phrase and screens mode/organization; the runtime's single NoRewindPhraseEffect overlays '07' on a successful open of a NonUnit connector after a normal open. Report files reach the same OpenTape path as any sequential file; nothing on it switches on the edition. Diagnostics at --std 85 cite §2023 clauses (a presentation matter outside this rule).

refuter.evidence: cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR8 ('The NO REWIND phrase will be ignored if it does not apply to the storage medium on which the file resides'). Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-05/c1: n1 'OPEN OUTPUT RPTF WITH NO REWIND RPTG SQ' (two report files and a sequential file in one OPEN, a USE AFTER ERROR declarative on RPTF) -> ST1=07 ST2=00 ST3=00 DCL=N: the phrase is ignored for its own file only, the open is successful and no declarative runs; then 'OPEN OUTPUT RPTF EXTEND RPTG OUTPUT SQ WITH NO REWIND' -> ST1=00 ST2=00 ST3=07, n1a.rpt emptied (OUTPUT: the file contains no records) and n1b.rpt keeps WORLD (EXTEND, normal open). Class c: n2 the 2002 'OPEN OUTPUT SHARING WITH NO OTHER' -> COBOL0900 requires COBOL-2002; n3 'WITH LOCK' on OPEN -> refused (COBOL5506). No hole.
